session: 2026-08-28 overnight control-plane build — P0 prerequisites, then the Autonomous Intelligence / Engineering Control Plane foundation attached to real Meanwhile obligations

workstreams.title: P0.1 — retire claude/g17-aud03-measure after re-proving the audit finding
P0.2 — WTP_PRODUCTION_DATABASE_URL_READONLY as a repository secret
workstreams.blockedReason: An owner/credential boundary, and the value's existence is not the blocker. The read-only production URL exists in the local authorized environment and is proven (credential-ledger row 33, role readonly on neondb); what is refused is copying a production credential into GitHub Actions, which widens what a compromised workflow can reach. The reading itself was taken LOCALLY this session and is green — 23 of 23 migrations applied, all 23 checksums matching. What the secret buys is CI taking the same reading unattended. Every dependent fails closed: an absent credential records CREDENTIAL_ABSENT and lib/ops/production-integrity.ts reads that as CREDENTIAL_MISSING, which is explicitly not green.

workstreams.title: P0.3 — production-integrity state and the release freeze, with no automatic rollback
Stage B1–B3 — WorkItem, RouteTask, Attempt, ExecutionLease, atomic dispositions, the completion evaluator
Stage D — the inherited route floor, computed from the typed method projection and the adapter's declared routes

dependencyReasons.control-plane-execution-core: Preflight materialises a RouteTask per inherited route and writes the floor into the WorkItem's CompletionContract. It consumes control-plane-execution-model — createRouteTask, WorkItem and CompletionContract are defined there.

workstreams.title: Stage B4 — the real MTG-13 obligation attached in shadow, proving completion is refused without /EventDates

dependencyReasons.method-runtime-preflight: The fixture's whole proof is that the floor is computed rather than typed. It consumes inherited-route-floor — computeRouteFloor and materializeFloor are defined by that workstream.

dependencyReasons.control-plane-execution-core: Artifacts are referenced by Attempt and RouteDisposition, and the vault reuses contentHash from lib/control-plane/ids.ts. It consumes control-plane-execution-model.

concurrencyEvidence: Ran concurrently with worker-policy-contracts and campaign-finance-fixtures. The three own disjoint file sets and exchange no artifact, so none can observe another's partial state.

concurrencyEvidence: Ran concurrently with evidence-vault-contract and campaign-finance-fixtures over disjoint owned paths.
